title: Extraction and Border
author: J. M. Marchetti
blurb: Ada Whitlock, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
